purpose: Primary-source desk research for the GDPR project concept and business analysis, not product testing or market validation.
research_method: Read official vendor, model-provider, regulator and researcher pages. Followed official links where available. Google terms were retrieved directly over HTTPS after the browser reader could not process the redirected Markdown response. No product login, sign-up, paid inference, customer contact or private trust-centre audit was performed.
interpretation_rules: A verified public vendor statement is not independent verification of capability, security, legal compliance or performance.
Public documentation does not establish this project's account entitlement, negotiated price, exact run version or source-isolation capability.
Model and product run versions and prices remain unconfigured until verified for a particular run and frozen before observing answers.
Open-weight examples establish the named release only; licence and serving assumptions must be checked for the exact selected checkpoint.
Research on different legal tasks, systems or historical versions cannot establish current GDPR accuracy for the candidates.
Financial examples are illustrative; no observed savings or willingness to pay is claimed.
